title: Identification of Bacterial Blight Resistant Rice Seeds Using Terahertz Imaging and Hyperspectral Imaging Combined With Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: Terahertz and hyperspectral measurements with CNNs classify bacterial-blight-resistant rice seeds against susceptible seeds; the paper reports held-out testing and comparisons with SVM/RF/PLS-DA. This is a specific seed-screening result, with same-pool sampling limiting independent generalization.
